title: Built a full online hacking sim, Instant terminal, root access, file system, TOR
author: Prudent_Definition67
selftext:
Greetings, I spent the last month vibe coding a game for the vibejam on X. I wanted to take a different approach and created VibeOS, a full online cyberpunk hacker operating system you boot straight into. 

\[Play here! Added light mobile support\](https://Vibehackos.com) 

Instant terminal, root access, file system, TOR, DarkNet, 

real-time victim alerts when you hack them. 💻

Steal files. Drain wallets. Nuke the city. 

Watch NASA/YouTube live on the in-game TV. 🌐 yes, I added a working ingame TV.

Games/Apps you can download in the vibemarket, 

Easter eggs!!

A fully functional website builder you can add to the vibe ecosystem. 

This is still in the early stages, but it's should be polished enough to share. I definitely would appreciate any feedback or tips.
